turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
Dinnerly Support · AI says:
Yes—an order can be canceled after placing it, but only before the cutoff. For most orders, the cutoff is 6–7 days before the scheduled delivery day, depending on your location. Once the order enters processing, it cannot be edited or canceled. Dinnerly says boxes are billed 5–6 days before delivery, with no changes after 11:59 pm the day before billing. Has payment for the week you want to cancel already been processed?

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. Sign in, open Orders, select the order, choose Edit recipes, continue to Market, select Add + for the item, and save your box. In the app, open Upcoming, choose the order, select Choose recipes, then add Market items before saving. Changes are allowed until 6–7 days before delivery, depending on location; after the cutoff or once processing begins, edits are unavailable. Also, has payment for the week you want to cancel already been processed?
